title: Dereth Town Tour - Khayyaban scratch

shots.standingOrder: Start low beside the old well in the sunken pit east of Khayyaban and rise straight up past its rim to reveal the terraced town and the ridge.
shots.notes: WATER / REVEAL (drone.boom-rise). Starts 2.5 m above the floor of the sunken pit east of the town, 12 m from the old well (water frame, bucket, the Destroyed Lin Portal beside it) and a palm, then rises straight up 47 m with a fixed -6 deg tilt: the pit rim drops away and the terraced town, the skeleton statue, the domes, the rooftop gardens and the ridge rise into view, front-lit by the late-morning sun behind.
